category_title: Students with physical disabilities who struggle with initial self-evaluation and volume of speech
minimal_context: The student is working on the 'Go for Goal!' self-evaluation report in a group setting during a Chinese lesson.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please fill out your 'Go for Goal!' self-evaluation report with your group. What are your strengths?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Love to do craft. When I encounter difficulties, I become brave. When I get the tasks from the teachers, I will be responsible for finishing them on time.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What are your goals for this term?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Speaking very quietly) I have to speak a bit louder, and try to ask people’s help to take notes. I need to learn to speak slowly.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Your group members are giving you advice on your goals right now. Please write down their comments.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Speaking too quickly and quietly, while struggling to take notes independently) My weakness is I do not like to listen to people’s advice.
